capabilities: Render [t] task lists as vertical timelines in Reading View
Customize dot separation, line padding, and detail spacing
Set separate light- and dark-mode colors for line, dots, and detail backgrounds
Collapse and expand timeline entries that have details
Override per-detail styles with inline CSS via STYLE[...]
extras: Installation via BRAT (beta channel) is documented; a space must follow [t] for the timeline to render; collapsible dots are off by default because they break Dataview TASK highlight behavior.
problem: Obsidian renders task lists as plain checkboxes, with no way to display a nested list as a vertical timeline.

relations.evidence: No issues were observed when using the Tasks plugin alongside this plugin.

summary: Renders task lists whose parent task has a [t] status as vertical timelines in Reading View, with adjustable spacing, colors, and collapsible details.
